CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting

  July 27, 2021

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present: Ankit Udani, Katie Chiu, Stanley Tsai, Nora Hernandez
  •  Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza
  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Erin Ung, Vist Yang

DISCUSSION AGENDA:

ITEM 1:
APPLICANT: 2000 South Campbell Avenue

Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that MWELO
compliance landscape drawings be provided during building plan check.

The applicant Ricky Lam and Devin Thai were present for Item number 1 and the staff report was
given.
There were no public comments.
There were no comments submitted by email prior to the meeting.

Chiu stated that the overall design was acceptable. Minor comments included that the roof bracket
in the front elevation is only in the corner. The north elevations have multiple brackets. To be
consistent, there should be a similar treatment and spacing on the front elevation. The three-panel
window on the front should The second consideration is for the kitchen window. There is no need
for an isolated section of the wainscot and could be removed. The semi-arched window is also not
logical. There can be either a window or a straight trim provided.

Hernandez agreed with Chiu regarding the window, which should be resized or centered. She also
stated that the entry gable was inconsistent with the other hip roofs.

Tsai questioned the setback for the garage. The front elevation still needs work. The connection
between the front entry element and the front living space element.

Chiu stated that if there is a redesign of the front elevation, it should be continued so that the board
can see the redesign. The rest of the board member agrees.

  1
 MOTION:
 •  Katie Chiu moved to continue the application to allow for redesign.
 •  The second was by Nora Hernandez.
 •  The motion carried by the following 4-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 2:
APPLICANT: 2619 West Valley Boulevard

Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions: 1. Sign
trim cap shall be white to match the sign face; and 2. All illegal signages along the East and West
elevation walls and window signages shall be removed prior to final Planning approval stamp.

The applicant: Jaime Toledo was present for Item number 1 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments.
There were no public comments submitted by email prior to the meeting.

The applicant questioned if the illegal window signage can remain. Abe stated that the DRB has
no power to approve illegal signage.

Chiu stated that the front elevation shows a structural rod that interferes with the second line of
copy. Tsai had the same concern. The applicant stated that it is up to the sign company but that
they will find a way to accommodate the structure. Chiu recommended that the applicant work
with staff on the graphics.

Hernandez stated that there is a possibility of the right justification of the second line of copy.
Udani concurred based on accurate drawings.

MOTION:
 •  Nora Hernandez moved to approved the application with the following conditions :1. The
  applicant shall work with staff on the placement of the second line of copy to not interfere
  with the façade structure; 2. The address number shall use color to match and meet the
  standard of the color palette; and 3. All revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved
  by DRB staff prior to permit issuance.
 •  The second was by Katie Chiu
 •  The motion carried by the following 4-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

  2
 ADJOURNMENT:
MOTION:
 •  Katie Chiu moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:15
 •  Seconded by Nora Hernandez.
 •  The motion carried by the following 3-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Jose Luis Espinoza, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 9th day of November, 2021.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
